scope_rule: All practical source deliverables in the approved phased integration programme remain required. Phases order work; they do not silently defer it beyond the next RC. External blockers require explicit disposition and are not automatic waivers. No new required-source deferrals introduced.

resource_policy.parallelism: maximum useful concurrency within aggregate limits; do not infer a higher cap from past superseded 20-core or four-by-four proposals

requirements.title: Native executable and full-engine parity
requirements.requirement: One compiled CIX executable; no required Python interpreter, embedded CPython, shell launcher, separate native-CIX/PAQ program or hidden extraction. Use native codec libraries and, where isolation is needed, the same CIX executable. Optional Python bindings call native code. Every shipping native/full-engine runtime profile satisfies this no-Python condition.
requirements.acceptance: Execution/load trace, dependency inventory, native ports of every retained successful route, clean install without Python.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Reusable library-first core
requirements.requirement: Extract the engine from CLI main; CLI, SDK and adapters share native codec/container/selection/resource code rather than embedding CLI side effects.
requirements.acceptance: Rust API plus C ABI consumer tests; no process exits, signals, unsolicited output, global resource-limit changes or implicit child processes in native embedding.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Generic automatic specialist selection
requirements.requirement: Accept arbitrary input bytes and discover standard formats/data structure without corpus names, hashes, known contents, benchmark offsets/lengths or saved streams. Supported format knowledge is allowed.
requirements.acceptance: Rename/misleading-extension equivalence, fresh runtime dependency audit, malformed recognizers fall back safely, whole generic alternatives remain eligible. Mathematical/process-based source naming does not prove corpus independence: separately inspect recognizer/admission predicates, offsets, hashes, saved-state inputs and renamed/misleading-extension fixtures. Validated standard-format recognition remains required; renaming must not remove specialist behavior.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Arbitrary heterogeneous input
requirements.requirement: Support varied structured/unstructured and known/unknown combinations, late/nonzero/interleaved/nested supported regions; text–numeric–text is only an example. Preserve unknown bytes.
requirements.acceptance: Deterministic mixed fixtures, arbitrary order and unknown prefix/middle/suffix, no hardcoded sequences, exact coverage, complete mixed versus unsplit competition.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Historical model and decoder coverage
requirements.requirement: Map all 12 portfolio26 winners, current useful generic routes and known-better references to actual native admission and decoders. Keep PAQ variants, image/JXL, molecular, numeric/grid, database and executable families where feasible.
requirements.acceptance: Per-route source/encoder/decoder/dependency/fixture manifest; all exclusions explicit and justified; no losing/rare route called dead code.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: FAST / DEFAULT / BEST semantics
requirements.requirement: FAST limits latency, DEFAULT balances cost, BEST minimizes complete valid bytes over its disclosed admitted search. DEFAULT means normal invocation. Search objective is separate from format or one fixed preset.
requirements.acceptance: Mode/candidate coverage matrix; considered/declined/budget-omitted/failed/completed/selected reasons; every feasible retained quality candidate accounted for.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Selection dimensions and overrides
requirements.requirement: Audit routes × backends × transforms × parameters × boundaries × history × containers. Explicit expert options constrain only their chosen dimensions; no override disables unrelated automatic optimization.
requirements.acceptance: CLI option matrix and targeted combination tests, deterministic priority/ties, exact complete-output selection where feasible; explain finite bounds honestly.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Paid representation and index packing
requirements.requirement: Charge every header, dictionary, boundary, model ID, constraint, reset, index and integrity field. Preserve exact combinatorial arithmetic and exploit applicable higher-dimensional packing without forcing CIX rank coding where another coder wins.
requirements.acceptance: Canonical/large-rank and full-frame equivalence; cost decomposition; no fixed-width rank truncation, hidden side information or payload-only winner claim.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Genuine bounded streaming
requirements.requirement: Non-seekable/unknown-length input read once with bounded blocks/history/queues, no whole-input spool; output before EOF; decode incrementally with backpressure.
requirements.acceptance: Actual idle producer pipe, partial input/output, slow consumer and stream larger than memory; first output/idle flush proof; footer/truncation checks.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Streaming and full-engine coverage contracts
requirements.requirement: Preserve supported history across flushes; declare whole-input-only models and capability/size limits. Remove silent specialist loss through current stdin/>128 MiB delegation; report any inherent limitation explicitly.
requirements.acceptance: Coverage report for file/pipe/large input; memory proof for CIXH/legacy output; explicit independent-block/reset semantics and coherent option errors.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Complete conventional CLI
requirements.requirement: Preserve cix/uncix/cixcat aliases as the same compiled implementation, -d/-c/-k/-f/-t/-l, levels, memory/workers, - and multi-file I/O, help/version, expert/stream controls and useful diagnostics.
requirements.acceptance: Behavior matrix including currently missing integrated-parser controls, clean binary stdout/stderr diagnostics, exit codes, help/man parity. Explicitly map -t/-l, --format, --route, --backend, --block-size, --history, --independent-blocks, --stream, --flush-interval, --parallelism, --profile, --portfolio, --external and thread-range behavior.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Safe file and interruption semantics
requirements.requirement: Preserve input by default, refuse unintended overwrite, temporary output plus atomic replacement, clean interruption/corrupt-input behavior and path handling.
requirements.acceptance: Existing-file/overwrite, failure/cancel/partial output tests; no archive or input lost; cleanup scoped to owned temporary files.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Maximum useful internal parallelism
requirements.requirement: Use global resource-aware scheduling across independent candidates, independent regions/blocks and work stages, including tail utilization. Preserve dependent model history and quality.
requirements.acceptance: Trace ready/running/waiting jobs, actual worker use and idle reasons; no nested oversubscription or silent context splitting; parallel determinism/cancellation checks.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Concurrent benchmark scheduling design
requirements.requirement: Replace unconditional one-file/phase serial scheduling with bounded admission across independent cells where resources permit. Reserve actual declared requirements, not an automatic four-core reservation for every job.
requirements.acceptance: Before future benchmark, prove scheduler fairness, no avoidable head-of-line blocking, per-cell/full-wave measurement attribution and consistent contention policy. No benchmark now.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Portable product resource controls
requirements.requirement: Standalone product enforces total memory, output, temporary storage, queue and worker limits without relying on research WaveScheduler. Explicit cancellation/deadlines and backend environment allowlisting. Distinguish accounted/estimated codec allocation from enforceable aggregate process RSS. Native SDK deadlines/cancellation are cooperative; non-preemptible library calls cannot promise immediate hard cancellation.
requirements.acceptance: Allocation/output bombs, timeout, child failure/descendant cleanup, cancellation isolation, temp exhaustion and environment tests; platform-specific guarantees documented. Document per-profile enforcement: allocations versus RSS, cancellation observation points, and hard termination only for explicitly isolated workers.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Performance carry-forward
requirements.requirement: Preserve exact rank/cardinality reuse, immutable fixedmix tables, borrowed PPM lookup, bounded readers, ordered backpressure, exact per-encode cache, T1 histogram avoidance and append-only pruning proof.
requirements.acceptance: Map each retained optimization to new source and exactness fixture; no additive/unmeasured speed claim; profile new bottlenecks without reopening closed experiments.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Hardware execution policy
requirements.requirement: Document sustainable CPU/cooling/power policy and isolate unrelated work where practical. Resolve intermittent thermal throttling and dynamic limits sufficiently for truthful qualification; no blind power-limit increase or automatic BIOS flash.
requirements.acceptance: Recorded busy MHz, watts, temperatures, throttle deltas, topology and interference policy; unresolved physical/maintenance dependencies explicit, not claimed fixed.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Historical wire compatibility
requirements.requirement: Retain all supported native and legacy frame decoders, binary/ASCII magic distinctions, exact joint-discount dispatch and installed dependency requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Old/new cross-decode and canonical archive equality where defined; version every intentional format change; never relabel old artifacts as new RC results.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: No hidden runtime inputs
requirements.requirement: Archive plus documented installed runtime must suffice. No source files, corpus caches, result certificates, network fetches, pretrained assets or undeclared dictionaries required.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh-process offline/archive-only restore and clean dependency closure; dictionary identity/distribution explicit where deliberately used.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Stable SDK buffer/context ABI
requirements.requirement: Stable Rust/C APIs: checked bounds, buffer compression/decompression, opaque reusable contexts, versioned/sized options, typed errors, explicit ownership and limits.
requirements.acceptance: Independent C/Rust consumer builds, bounds/invalid option/allocation tests, ABI/version behavior; concurrent distinct contexts with isolated state.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: SDK incremental I/O and chunks
requirements.requirement: Process/flush/finish/reset, consumed/produced counts, needs-input/output/finished statuses, callbacks, Rust Read/Write and independent chunks with compressed/stored outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: One-byte/irregular I/O, backpressure, reset, flush/footer, no-compression and independent chunk tests; cix_squash_splice remains compatible wrapper.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Native versus full-engine interfaces
requirements.requirement: Expose both capabilities explicitly. Native SDK is process-free and host-scheduled (one worker default); full engine exposes complete eligible specialist coverage and explicit same-CIX worker isolation.
requirements.acceptance: No implicit promotion to subprocess mode; target-decoder capability admission, operation budgets, deterministic-mode contract and separate API/wire/dependency compatibility. Native embedding cannot enforce process RSS by changing caller-wide limits; advertise cooperative versus hard deadlines accurately and test each promised contract.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Full-engine job protocol
requirements.requirement: Versioned same-executable SDK/job mode with capabilities, structured request/result/error records, separate binary transport, progress/cancel and complete coverage reporting.
requirements.acceptance: Protocol/version negotiation, malformed request, cancellation, concurrency and binary framing tests; no separate cix-engine executable dependency.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: SDK development artifacts
requirements.requirement: Public header, Rust docs, C++ RAII, static/shared libraries, pkg-config, CMake package metadata and small installed embedding examples.
requirements.acceptance: Build independent consumers from a clean install; link/load and uninstall checks; document supported capability and resource contracts.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Genuine standard compression formats
requirements.requirement: Add --output-format and SDK equivalent for gzip/zlib/raw DEFLATE/bzip2/xz/Zstd/Brotli, plus LZ4 frame and Snappy framed. Keep --format CIX-container and wrapped --external/CIXB1 semantics distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Independent tool interoperability; explicit selection for ambiguous raw formats; malformed/streaming tests and exact byte restoration.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Dictionary APIs
requirements.requirement: Dictionary handles and Zstd training/use first; expose support per codec with dictionary identity, ownership and resource bounds. No unversioned CIX dictionary extension.
requirements.acceptance: Correct/missing/wrong dictionary, reset, immutable sharing and installed consumer tests; charge/disclose decoder-required dictionary assets.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Tar and libarchive integration
requirements.requirement: Qualify tar -I, pipelines/stdin/stdout/-d, libarchive external filter and optional native adapter with exact contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Real create/extract, binary pipe/error behavior, installed examples and explicit plugin/library dependency. Optional native route cannot masquerade as stock support.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: QuixDB Squash plugin
requirements.requirement: Use public SDK for buffer/stream/splice with accurate bounds/options/flush claims; preserve compatibility wrapper; distinguish from SquashFS.
requirements.acceptance: Actual pinned SDK/runtime plugin discovery, loading, encoding and decoding; missing Squash 0.8 remains an explicit dependency, not a passed callback-only substitute.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: 7-Zip adapter
requirements.requirement: Provide CIX coder adapter with explicit method/version IDs and decoder distribution; keep ZIP compatibility separate.
requirements.acceptance: Actual host load/create/extract and missing decoder/version failures; external identifier requirements recorded.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: HDF5 / h5py / netCDF
requirements.requirement: Native chunk filter with parameters, capabilities, bounds and truthful filter identity.
requirements.acceptance: Actual HDF5 and netCDF/h5py consumer reopen/read, independent chunks, incompressible fallback, corrupted metadata and plugin absence checks.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Numcodecs / Zarr
requirements.requirement: Provide Numcodecs configuration/registration and Zarr v2 codec, plus distinct v3 BytesBytesCodec.
requirements.acceptance: Installed v2/v3 consumer write/reopen/random chunk read, serialized config, missing codec and corruption tests.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Blosc2
requirements.requirement: Native codec plugin with size bounds, versioning and host-compatible incompressible handling.
requirements.acceptance: Actual plugin registration, buffer/chunk roundtrip, bounds and no-compression outcome tests.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: RocksDB / WiredTiger
requirements.requirement: Pinned experimental RocksDB CompressionManager adapter and WiredTiger WT_COMPRESSOR sizing/compress/decompress behavior.
requirements.acceptance: Real database/SST write/reopen/upgrade checks, compression-declined behavior, concurrency and dependency-version matrix.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Hadoop and seekable chunks
requirements.requirement: CompressionCodec lifecycle and streams, independent chunks and optional archive-identity-bound seek index. Splittable/random-access support only when proved.
requirements.acceptance: Real JVM consumer, partial/seek reads and index identity validation; no hidden cross-chunk state or claim that random read verifies whole archive.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Primary language bindings
requirements.requirement: C/C++, Rust and Python bindings over native library; Python optional for Python consumers, never required by standalone CIX.
requirements.acceptance: Installed consumer buffer/file-like/stream tests, ownership/lifetime/error/cancel behavior and cross-language decode.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Additional language bindings
requirements.requirement: Go cgo, Java JNI, .NET P/Invoke and Node Node-API; idiomatic buffers/streams/disposal/cancellation.
requirements.acceptance: Actual independent consumer build/use, cross-interface decode, repeated calls and resource/lifetime checks on stated hosts.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Portable WASM subset
requirements.requirement: Native portable subset with browser stream wrappers and explicit capabilities; no process-dependent specialist claim.
requirements.acceptance: Browser/WASM build and execute, bounds/stream/cancel tests, exact supported-format compatibility.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: gRPC and HTTP
requirements.requirement: gRPC negotiation/message caps; standard gzip/br/zstd HTTP interoperability and explicitly negotiated CIX between controlled endpoints.
requirements.acceptance: Real endpoints, negotiation, missing decoder, oversized message and streaming/error tests; no unregistered stock-browser CIX claim.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: GIO / GStreamer and storage examples
requirements.requirement: Byte-stream adapters with flush/EOS/cancel; object-storage/backup examples with manifests/indexes.
requirements.acceptance: Actual pipeline/plugin load tests, partial I/O and restore examples; no transparent server-side decompression claim.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Native SquashFS userspace
requirements.requirement: Distinct CIX adapters for mksquashfs/unsquashfs/libsquashfs/squashfuse, bounded independent storage profile, data/metadata/fragment/xattr handling. Do not substitute opaque .cix transport.
requirements.acceptance: Actual create/extract/userspace read/random block checks; raw fallback; profile and custom identity explicit; no reuse of another codec ID.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Native SquashFS restricted decoder and VM
requirements.requirement: Small bounded portable native decoder for the chosen storage profile, differential to Rust; experimental kernel integration and disposable-VM mount qualification.
requirements.acceptance: Actual mount/read/corruption/resource/metadata/fragment tests in disposable VM, matching tools/kernel, no host kernel modification or stock-support claim.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Additional platform format proposals
requirements.requirement: EROFS, Btrfs, OpenZFS, ZIP, Parquet, Arrow IPC and OCI require individual compatibility proposals and feasible CIX-owned prototypes; distinguish standard-format alternatives.
requirements.acceptance: Each target has design/prototype status, identity/licensing/upstream dependency and owner. Concrete promised proposal/prototype work remains required; upstream acceptance cannot be fabricated.
requirements.disposition_reason: Source/proposal obligations retained; stock/upstream acceptance depends on external parties and is not promised.

requirements.title: Platform qualification
requirements.requirement: Linux x86-64/ARM64, macOS ARM64/x86-64 and Windows x64 source/build/binding coverage; actual execution required for qualification, not cross-compile alone.
requirements.acceptance: Clean install and independent consumers per supported target; absent runners/dependencies listed as external blockers; no silent exclusion or false platform claim.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Lean professional distribution
requirements.requirement: Reproducible root build/install, allowlisted source export excluding research/datasets/evidence, conventional layout/README/man/help/examples, native runtime dependencies, Debian/RPM and appropriate Mac/Windows packaging. Use consistent conventional shipping file/directory layout and names describing mathematical operations or processes; exclude corpus/member-derived and file-type-inference names such as the rejected chemical.rs.
requirements.acceptance: Clean third-party source build, package install/uninstall/use, offline/runtime closure and artifact identity; host-pinned staging is not a release installer. Check shipping source/install manifest and rename references against the naming rule, without altering frozen historical evidence or third-party codec provenance/names. Preserve semantics, registry coverage and compatibility through CIX-owned renames.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Licenses and provenance
requirements.requirement: Preserve all codec source identities/notices and dependency/linking/license requirements; project license proposal does not relicense third-party code.
requirements.acceptance: Source hashes, dependency manifest, install-size accounting and compatible package scopes; keep repository private and Actions disabled.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Sonar C/C++ actually works
requirements.requirement: Execute proven CXX analysis including CIX and vendor visibility; prepared plugin is not completion. Replace stale all-36-verified gate with exact authenticated stop/idle/lease contract.
requirements.acceptance: Actual rule/probe issue detection, compiler metadata, indexed-file/language coverage, compute-engine completion and issue readback; final scan bound to final RC source.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Quality and dead-code closure
requirements.requirement: Final formatting, Clippy warnings policy, Sonar, appropriate native checks and proven dead-code removal. Repairs restricted to CIX-owned code/build/adapters/tooling.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh final-source checks; separate unresolved vendor findings; no vendor edits/suppression to fake clean, no supported decoder or rare specialist removed as dead code.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Focused correctness and robustness
requirements.requirement: Validate actual release paths, historical/cross-interface decode, arbitrary/empty/mixed input, malformed/truncated/trailing data, bounded expansion, concurrency and cancellation isolation; relevant fuzzing.
requirements.acceptance: Current-source receipts, failures resolved, independent archive-only decode and clean-installed consumer checks. Reuse fixtures; no long corpus benchmark while gate open.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Optimized build and reproducibility
requirements.requirement: Optimize measured bottlenecks; retain qualified O3/LTO/CGU/SIMD choices with portable dispatch. PGO/allocator changes require evidence, not blanket tuning.
requirements.acceptance: Final optimized build passes checks; compiler/linker/dependency/flags/CPU support identities frozen; no unsafe fast-math change to codec semantics.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Complete opportunity/backlog disposition
requirements.requirement: Reconcile every historical queued method by distinct mechanism and actual source/evidence, including original Squash-codec inventory. Keep closed negative and unproven research separate from missing required product features. Include the newly requested GPU/CUDA opportunity investigation: host capability, applicable kernels, transfer/setup costs, memory, deterministic precision, native library integration and CPU fallback. Investigation is required; speculative GPU implementation is not. Extend GPU research beyond accelerating current CIX paths to additional lossless GPU compression methodologies and implications for throughput, interoperability, SDK features, dependencies, packages and distribution.
requirements.acceptance: No unexplained pending code item; implemented/partial/backend-only/closed-negative/unproven/external statuses with owner/evidence. Later generic-format clarification supersedes old format bans. Link the bounded GPU/CUDA findings and disposition (justified opportunity, no demonstrated benefit, or explicit blocker); do not claim an unmeasured speedup or launch a GPU benchmark while HOLD remains. Candidate matrix must distinguish already-supported, source-integration opportunity, externally constrained and rejected/unproven methods; record hardware/API/licensing/format/portability/resource/CPU-fallback implications and conditional source requirements without making every researched method mandatory.
requirements.disposition_reason: Finite research closure maps38 historical cells and11 current groups, with final count/seeded-space and codec validations. No new experimental routes promoted. Keep all required useful-specialist/native/SDK/hygiene capabilities. New-source mapping and final acceptance remain open; this is not a universal opportunity-exhaustion claim.

requirements.title: Release and benchmark gate
requirements.requirement: No new benchmark until every required source/quality/compatibility/performance row is accepted and source, binary, dependency, options, limits and harness identities frozen.
requirements.acceptance: Machine-readable readiness receipt plus independent acceptance review. Missing external dependency is a blocker, not an automatic waiver; no hidden or newly invented deferral.
requirements.disposition_reason: Required before next RC benchmark; earlier implementation/test evidence must be mapped to new source.

requirements.title: Later single-pass confirmation
requirements.requirement: After gate only: one FAST/DEFAULT/BEST pass on canonical Silesia, each with fresh independently timed archive-only decode and maximum useful bounded concurrency.
requirements.acceptance: Complete bytes and full search/decode CPU/wall/MiB/s/aggregate peaks, coverage/omissions, historical per-member/total comparison and scoped public records. No current benchmark launch.

requirements.title: Later reporting and publication

gate_rule: All listed pre_benchmark_prerequisites and pre_benchmark_external_obligations need accepted current-RC evidence before RC51 review. Conditional external outcomes also need evidence if their stock-support claim is made. RC51 readiness binds the freeze/benchmark plan and independent review; only then can HOLD transition to READY. RC52 remains required after the transition and must never be a prerequisite for itself. This consistency contract does not authenticate test receipts or authorize changing scope.

external_obligations.requirement: Owned per-format proposals, feasible prototypes, source/compatibility evidence and explicit infeasibility evidence where applicable. A pending upstream decision does not excuse missing owned work.
Real pinned host SDK/runtime/toolchain/runner evidence needed by actual promised consumer/platform qualification. Unavailable dependencies keep corresponding required IDs open.
Each adapter/format has collision-free documented development identity and explicit experimental-versus-stock compatibility profile. No invented registration or existing codec-ID reuse.
Actual upstream/standard acceptance and qualified stock support required before claiming stock support for format extensions; a documented experimental proposal/prototype does not establish it.
Real registry allocation/upstream release and interoperability evidence before claiming registered/stock-compatible integration. Experimental CIX-owned work remains separately required.

additional_investigations.scope: Bounded source/prior-art/host opportunity audit; no GPU experiment/benchmark or speculative implementation commitment. Expanded to additional lossless GPU compression methods and SDK/interoperability/package/distribution requirements; derive conditional source obligations from evidence, not mandatory adoption of every candidate.
